name: AI Tracker Stats
author: ashleyjackson

sections.faq:
• Will this slow down my website?
    No. The plugin runs server-side and does not affect client-facing performance.

  • Do I need a subscription?
    A free trial is available. Afterward, a small monthly fee applies. Subscription management is handled via the plugin interface.

  • What data is collected?
    Only information related to AI agent access is logged. No personal visitor data is collected.

  • How long is data retained?
    Data is stored for 91 days before automatic deletion.

Empower your WordPress site with visibility and control over AI access—install AI Tracker Stats today!
sections.description:
AI Tracker Stats WordPress Plugin

Overview

AI Tracker Stats is a WordPress plugin designed to help website owners monitor, analyze, and control AI agent access to their WordPress sites. With the rise of AI-powered bots and scrapers, it’s more important than ever to understand who is accessing your content and how your data is being used. This plugin provides real-time detection, secure analytics, and actionable insights to protect your site from unwanted AI activity.

Key Features

  • AI Agent Detection: Automatically identifies and logs visits from known AI bots and agents.
  • Comprehensive Analytics: View detailed statistics on AI access attempts, including frequency, source, and trends.
  • Data Privacy: All collected data is stored securely and is only accessible to authorized website owners.
  • Easy Installation: Simple download and activation process—no complex configuration required.
  • Data Retention: Logs are retained for 91 days, giving you ample time to review and download your data.
  • Subscription Support: Free trial available; ongoing service for a small monthly fee. Heavy usage plans available on request.

Why Use AI Tracker Stats?

  • Understand Your Content: Know how AI agents interact with your site, and update your SEO’s based on actionable intelligence.
  • Gain Insights: Understand how AI agents interact with your site and make informed decisions about your content strategy.
  • Compliance & Transparency: Maintain control over your site’s data and ensure compliance with privacy standards.
  • No Performance Impact: The plugin operates entirely server-side, ensuring zero impact on your site’s speed or user experience.

External Services

Our application uses external services loacted at https://aitrackerstats.com/.

We use this domain to:

  • Register your domain in our infrastructure
  • Detect your domains Status
  • Push User Agents, Path’s accessed and domain to our tracking endpoint.
  • Access Dashboards for your domains
  • Access available downloads for your domains
  • Check for Plugin Updates (To be removed later when Plugin is accepted in WordPress Directory)

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 (or later) license. For more details, please refer to the GNU General Public License.
